task.title: AI-assisted full-stack mini app · expense approvals
task.goal: Generate a working expense-approval app from a one-line requirement (frontend + API + storage + auth)
task.context: RAD · vibe coding · runs in one click

userStory.trigger: Wanted a small expense-approval tool and gave a one-line requirement
userStory.goal: Get a working v0 and know what to decide next
userStory.reads: The agent's read on "what to build": the requirement, the architecture decisions that passed self-checks, what's been generated, and the choices still open
userStory.acts: Confirm the state set / notification channel to have it generate v1 / dispute an architecture decision / add requirements

observablePrimitives.label: Requirement: employee submits expense → manager approves → finance pays out

nodes.title: Requirement as understood: three roles (employee/manager/finance) + attachments + state transitions + auth

evidence.label: roles and flow unpacked from the one-line requirement

steps.observed: derived three-role RBAC and a state machine from the requirement

nodes.title: From single-page CRUD to state-machine-driven
nodes.from: A single-page CRUD with one form + a list
nodes.to: An approval state machine (draft→submitted→approved/rejected→paid) + role-based routing
nodes.rationale: "Approval" is fundamentally about state transitions and permission boundaries; plain CRUD can't express who can do what in which state — a state machine is the right skeleton.

nodes.title: Stack: Bun + Hono API + SQLite + a minimal React frontend, 3-role RBAC

evidence.label: meets the lightweight / one-click-deploy / offline-first constraints

steps.observed: the stack fits the deployment constraints

nodes.title: Generated 7 files + migration + seed data, local self-check passes

steps.observed: three tables created, seed data written

nodes.title: Next: generate the approval state machine and migration (pending your confirmation of the state set)
nodes.falsification: If the state set needs intermediate states like "finance returns for more documents," the state machine and permission matrix change accordingly; confirm the state set with you before generating.

nodes.title: Notification channel undecided (email / Mattermost / in-app)
nodes.needs: Which approval-notification channel do you prefer? It affects whether we introduce an external dependency and config options.

nodes.title: Attachments use local disk; production needs object storage
nodes.falsification: For a small internal trial, local disk is acceptable; once you go multi-replica / production, you must switch to object storage or attachments will be lost.

nodes.title: Plain CRUD with a single-page form + list
nodes.reason: Can't express state transitions or role permission boundaries — at odds with the semantics of "approval."

outcome.label: v0 generated · Grounded
outcome.text: A runnable v0 is generated (state-machine skeleton + three-role RBAC + local self-check passing).
outcome.recommendation: Generate v1 once the state set and notification channel are confirmed; switch attachments to object storage before production.
